question: hard_braking
prefix:
Signals of the vehicle:
1. longitudinal acceleration, negative when braking, in m/s^2 (ESP12.LONG_ACCEL, from ECU ESC)
2. pressure of the brake circuit, in bar (ESP12.CYL_PRES, from ECU ESC)
3. vehicle speed, in km/h (CLU11.CF_Clu_Vanz, from ECU CLU)
Relations between them:
- with pressure in the brake circuit, the longitudinal acceleration is negative (1, 2)
- the rate of change of the speed is the longitudinal acceleration, apart from the slope of the road (1, 3)
Question: Does the vehicle brake hard in this window? Braking is hard when the longitudinal acceleration goes below -2 m/s^2.
Options: yes, no
Each window gives, for every signal: last value, minimum, maximum, mean and change (last minus first).

question: turning
prefix:
Signals of the vehicle:
1. steering wheel angle, positive to the left, in deg (SAS11.SAS_Angle, from ECU MDPS)
2. yaw rate, in deg/s (ESP12.YAW_RATE, from ECU ESC)
Question: Which way does the vehicle turn in this window? It turns when the steering wheel angle goes beyond 30 deg to either side. If it turns both ways, answer the side of the larger angle.
Options: left, right, straight
Each window gives, for every signal: last value, minimum, maximum, mean and change (last minus first).

question: speed_band
prefix:
Signals of the vehicle:
1. vehicle speed, in km/h (CLU11.CF_Clu_Vanz, from ECU CLU)
Question: How fast is the vehicle going at the end of this window? Below 1 km/h it is stopped, below 30 km/h slow, below 80 km/h medium, and from 80 km/h fast.
Options: stopped, slow, medium, fast
Each window gives, for every signal: last value, minimum, maximum, mean and change (last minus first).

question: speed_trend
prefix:
Signals of the vehicle:
1. vehicle speed, in km/h (CLU11.CF_Clu_Vanz, from ECU CLU)
Question: Does the vehicle get faster, get slower or keep a steady speed over this window? It is steady when the speed changes by less than 5 km/h.
Options: faster, slower, steady
Each window gives, for every signal: last value, minimum, maximum, mean and change (last minus first).

question: idling
prefix:
Signals of the vehicle:
1. vehicle speed, in km/h (CLU11.CF_Clu_Vanz, from ECU CLU)
2. engine speed, in rpm (EMS11.N, from ECU EMS)
Question: Does the vehicle stand still with the engine running for the whole window? It stands still below 1 km/h, and the engine runs above 300 rpm.
Options: yes, no
Each window gives, for every signal: last value, minimum, maximum, mean and change (last minus first).

Question: Does the vehicle slow down without the brake in this window? It slows down when the speed drops by more than 3 km/h, and the brake is in use when the pressure goes above 3 bar.
Options: yes, no
Each window gives, for every signal: last value, minimum, maximum, mean and change (last minus first).
